laws.tier_note: mirrors the r155 water-fx tier closed set; dusk 0.55 / night 1.0; day+dark hours zero
laws.core_rows: windows with h >= 6 get the middle 2 rows drawn in core_rgb (soft interior glow)
laws.z_note: same-order z-toward-camera trick (r155 water / r158 light-fx family): renders above the order-3 city tilemaps at z 0, below props 4 / signs 6 / street 7 / tint 8
laws.hash_note: date = Beijing calendar date (day-stable, cross-day variety, same-input-same-output per day); widx = window scan order (row-major cells, family rect order)

rate_law_v2.floor_factor: linear per wall row bottom->top: 1.0 -> 0.6 (factor = 1.0 - 0.4 * (row_from_bottom / (wallRows - 1)); wallRows == 1 -> 1.0) - denser low, sparser high per art-target-dusk
rate_law_v2.impl: ThresholdFor / Fnv / widx enumeration UNCHANGED; the adapter multiplies BASE_RATE * factor at the single LitAt call site (duskgold-manifest impl_note)
rate_law_v2.band_check: overall lit fraction at activity 1.0 in [0.20, 0.30] every calendar date; pinned r181 (base 0.30 ramp, PER-BUILDING widx domain = the C#/r159 canon LitAt(bid|date|k); the r180 sweep's global-counter widx was a harness domain bug, pins independently re-derived): 2026-09-26=0.2305 / 09-27=0.2515 / 09-28=0.2485 / 09-29=0.2395 / 09-30=0.2515
rate_law_v2.rejected: BASE 0.25 + ramp = 3/5 dates under band; BASE 0.25 flat = in band but no denser-low law
rate_law_v2.v1_note: v1 (baked_round 159) lit 100 pct of windows at live activity 1.0 - the art-spec 'all-lit windows are fake' violation, census-caught r174/r180

laws.zone_rate: QUANT->quant, GAME_MAIN+GAME_ANNEX->gaming, MEDIA->media; north bank -> 'city' = round(mean(gaming,quant,media), 2)
laws.activity_note: activity is LIVE from world-state (scan floors: gaming 0.5 when any biggame machine online, media 0.4 with bs orders). Zero static baked numbers.
laws.rect_math: window world rect = cell [cx,cx+1]x[cy,cy+1] with art offsets: x = cx + ax/16, y_top = (cy+1) - ay/16, h = ah/16 downward

t_wall_gray_a.mode_note: tile 035 is the eave-transition wall (zero glass px, sandbox-asserted); the tileset ships no window variant for it - windows are RHYTHM-DRAWN at the exact gray_c art positions so the city-wide window rhythm stays one law

t_wall_gray_b.mode_note: tile 057 is the vertical plank wall (plank faces x1-3/5-7/9-11/13-15, seams x0/4/8/12 - sandbox-asserted); 1px vertical window slits on plank-face centers x2/6/10/14, same y5-12 band
